message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
with open('header.c') as f:
    content = f.read()
old = """    if (!hrecs->pgs_changed || !hrecs->npg)
        return 0;"""
new = """    fprintf(stderr, "DEBUG: entering link_pg pgs_changed=%d npg=%d\\n", hrecs->pgs_changed, hrecs->npg);
    if (!hrecs->pgs_changed || !hrecs->npg)
        return 0;"""
assert old in content
content = content.replace(old, new)
with open('header.c', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)
print("patched")
PYEOF
make -j$(nproc) libhts.a CFLAGS="-g -O1 -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer" 2>&1 | tail -1 && gcc -g -O1 -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -I. -o /tmp/harness /tmp/harness.c libhts.a -lz -lbz2 -llzma -lcurl -lcrypto -lpthread -ldeflate 2>&1 | tail -1 && echo OK` executed with exit code 0.
